name: firefox-statement-downloader-extension
description: Firefox extension that bulk-downloads statements and related financial documents from supported institutions.

scripts.build: mkdir -p dist && zip -FS -X dist/firefox-statement-downloader-extension.zip manifest.json background.js content.js core/*.js providers/*.js README.md
scripts.check: node --check background.js && node --check content.js && for file in core/*.js providers/*.js; do node --check "$file"; done
